name: AIMarket nearby sensors
description: The nearest live public sensors to a point, one per layer you ask for (weather, air, radiation, quake): each with its reading, distance and source, plus the hub's signed receipt. Method: POST, JSON body {"latitude":35.68,"longitude":139.69,"layers":["weather","air"]}. Pays 0.03 USDC on Base to the payTo in the endpoint's own 402.
